title: PB&J, Quick Version
original:
* Get bread
* Get peanut butter
* Get jelly
* Take a butter knife and spread the peanut butter on on side of a piece of bread
* Spread the jelly on the other piece of bread
* Put the halves together with the peanut butter and jelly touching
* eat

steps.note: The bag is closed, so 'bread' is the bag.
Hands full: the bag goes on the chef hat.

steps.text: Take a butter knife and spread the peanut butter on on side of a piece of bread
steps.note: 'on on side' read as 'on one side'. The jar is closed, so the knife scrapes the lid and spreads nothing.

steps.text: Spread the jelly on the other piece of bread
steps.note: No tool named for the jelly and the jar is closed, so Chef Byte rubs the whole jar on the bag.

steps.text: Put the halves together with the peanut butter and jelly touching

actions.why: Halves? There is only one bag of bread.

steps.note: There is only the bag. Confused.

missing: Open the bread bag and take out two slices.
Open both jars before you spread.
Use the knife for the jelly too.

fixes.text: Untwist the tie and open the bread bag.
Take two slices of bread out of the bag.
Use the knife to spread the jelly on the other piece of bread

result: A closed bag of bread on Chef Byte's hat, with nothing on it. Both jars are still closed.
